Terrible service
Sep 2018 • Couples
By far the most terrible service I have ever had in a restaurant and far below any i have experienced in vietnam. The food was acceptable but not good and very expensive for the at best average quality.

Ordered a glass of red wine and a beer whilst we decided what to eat. The waiter did not bring any drinks and waited till we ordered food. When the drinks arrived they brought white wine not red so had to try again.

I was then told they had run out of the calamari I had ordered as a starter, the head waiter presumed I would therefore not want a stater, so when I said if I could have chicken wings instead I got a shocked look and a response of 'your food is ready'. We were brought the starter my wife had ordered and then the mains. As I had not yet had my starter I cancelled it only to be presented by a bill for the starter I had not had. They did take it off the bill when challenge.

I guess I could blame the waiter as he was very new there and was struggling. However he advised us at the start he was new and we said would not be an issue, he was not the problem. Personally I think it is a lack of customer care from management as the head waiter could not care less if he tried.

Please just eat elsewhere and if you want a great burger go to Hoi An and visit Jim's Snack Bar.

Disappointed in the end
May 2016 • Family
We have enjoyed eating at Al Fresco's in the past. The food is good, the service polite, and the restaurant clean and enjoyable. 

I ordered the seafood pasta and noticed a clam that was shut closed. I often eat clams and a basic rule of thumb is not to eat the closed clams. I put it aside and tried to forget about it. Minutes later I pulled a piece of plastic out of my mouth that probably came from a plastic bag. Again I tried not to make a big deal in front of my family. 

When the server came to ask how everything was, I showed her the closed clam and the plastic. She offered to replace my meal, but by that point my children had finished their meal and I was full. The server agreed to take 50% off my meal. I was satisfied with the effort to make amends. 

Unfortunately that was not what happened. Instead they changed their minds and decided to give me a credit on my next meal. I felt that this was deceiving since they didn't follow through on their original message to me. Changing the credit behind my back without saying anything is dishonest. Plus, it assumes I will want to come back. If they wanted to change the credit policy, at least talk to the customer about it.

I am still undecided as to whether or not we will return.
